prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful and won (+5.2%), though evidence remains thin with only one test.
Wait-time information changes on home (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for most other specific categories (adoption/new_screen, choose_path changes, finish/redesign, home/hint, sign_in/copy), as each has only one test.
Predictions were consistently too high across almost all tests.
Reordering sign-in was significantly underpredicted (+1.0% predicted vs +5.2% after noise correction).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +0.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Photo Upload Screen Layout: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen into a clean split-column layout featuring a helpful visual mascot guide alongside photo pickers. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with mean completion taking over 1000s, indicating photo upload confusion and high drop-off.)
1: [home, layout] Waiting Screen Two-Column Layout with Animated Activity: Switch the waiting screen layout to a two-column design featuring an animated mascot alongside rotating tips while generation finishes. (why: The waiting step has a high mean time of 2336s and 18.7% drop-off; improved visual engagement reduces perceived load friction.)
2: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Instant Setup Helper Hint: Add a prominent contextual hint explaining that chosen pet paths can be changed or expanded anytime later in app settings. (why: Choose path drop-off is 23.8% with high mean completion time (514s), signaling hesitation from users worried about permanent choices.)
3: [finish, notification] Home Intro Desktop Sound & Launch Notification: Enable desktop sound cue playback and ready notifications on the home intro screen prior to pet spawning. (why: 3 support tickets reported issues with pets not being noticed on screen or appearing missing when desktop windows overlap.)
4: [adoption, hint] Pick Friend Quick Selection Guidance Hint: Add a helpful tip on the Pick Friend screen clarifying that standard pets spawn instantly while custom pets take additional setup. (why: Adoption has the highest step drop-off (39.1%) and users spend significant time deciding between instant vs custom pet creation.)

Home step has lower drop-off (18.7%); wait time info shows mild positive lift (+1.1%) but layout overhaul requires full release.
Choose path has 23.8% drop-off; hint changes have limited historical success so expected lift is minimal.
